text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Autumn of the Classic Year. The media 
described Tamamo Cross as "Ritto's Secret 
Weapon," but added, "she won't reach her 
true potential until next year."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Dissatisfied with her evaluations, Tamamo 
Cross entered the Kikuka Sho with fierce 
determination, vowing to seize victory 
there too.
